 These Metro Detroit businesses are offering freebies for military members this Veterans Day
 Several businesses are offering special promotions for veterans, active military members and their families across the state
 Jenny Sherman , Digital Content Producer
 Published:  November 11, 2026 at 11:18 AM Tags:  Veterans Day , Metro Detroit (WJXT) Restaurants and businesses across Southeast Michigan are offering special discounts or freebies to veterans and active-duty military members on Wednesday in honor of Veterans Day, Nov. 11, 2026.
 Though not always required, it’s recommended that those wanting to take advantage of local Veterans Day promotions bring along a military ID, driver’s license with a Veteran designation, or U.S. Uniformed Services Retired ID Card.
 Recommended Videos
 Here’s a quick guide to Veterans Day promotions available to military members in Metro Detroit: 
 Achatz Pies: Free slice of pie with proof of service. 
 Applebee’s : Free dine‑in entrée from a special Veterans Day menu. Beverages and gratuity not included and proof of service is required 
 Bar Louie: Free burger of choice (excluding the Big Louie). Offer is valid for dine-in only at participating locations 
 Big Boy: Free breakfast buffet for veterans at participating locations until 11 a.m. 
 Buffalo Wild Wings: 10 free boneless wings and fries (dine-in or walk-in orders only) 
 Beyond Juicery + Eatery: Starting Wednesday, veterans, active military members, EMTs, firefighters, and police officers can enjoy 20% off in-store purchases, every day, with a valid ID 
 Blind Owl: Offering one free entree (dine-in only) 
 Bob Evans: One free meal from a special menu (dine-in only) 
 Bonefish Grill: Free Bang Bang Shrimp entree and non-alcoholic beverage 
 Carrabba’s Italian Grill: Free appetizer or dessert (dine-in only) 
 Chili’s : Free entree from a select Veterans Day menu (dine‑in only) 
 Circle K: Free medium hot or iced coffee 
 Chipotle : Free chips plus a choice of guacamole, queso blanco or salsa with a $5 purchase (at participating locations) 
 Denny’s : Free Original Grand Slam breakfast until 12 p.m. Wednesday (dine-in only) 
 Dunkin’ Donuts: One free donut 
 Einstein Bros. Bagels: One free coffee and bagel with cream cheese (dine-in only at participating locations) 
 Emagine Entertainment: Free film showing of their choice at any Michigan, Indiana, Illinois, and Wisconsin Emagine Theatre location 
 Eddie Merlot’s: Free cheeseburger and fries while supplies last (dine-in only) 
 Firehouse Subs: Buy-one-get-one free subs (in-store only) 
 Ford’s Garage: Free burger entree or up to $16 off any other entree of their choice 
 Golden Corral : Free buffet (dine-in only) 
 Great Clips : Free haircut 
 IHOP: Free Red, White & Blue Pancake Combo until 7 p.m. 
 MJR Theatres: Free film screening of their choice at any MJR location 
 Outback Steakhouse: Free Bloomin’ Onion® and choice of fountain drink or 16 oz. domestic draft beer 
 Red Lobster : Free Shrimp & Chips meal (dine‑in only) 
 Red Robin : Free Red’s Big Tavern Burger with bottomless fries (dine‑in only) 
 Ruby Tuesday : Free “Everyday Fresh Meal” up to $17.99, including choice of one of 13 select entrees. The Garden Bar and a bottomless drink (dine-in only at participating locations) 
 Shake Shack : Free single ShackBurger (dine-in only) 
 Smashburger : Free All‑American Smashburger (at participating locations) 
 Starbucks : Veterans, service members and spouses receive a free 12‑oz hot or iced brewed coffee (at participating locations) 
 Texas Roadhouse : Free meal vouchers for veterans and active military members that can be redeemed through May 31, 2027 (at participating locations) 
 Twin Peaks : Free entree, including a choice of five meals (dine-in only at participating locations) 
 Yard House : Free appetizer (at participating locations) 
 Kohl’s : Offering 30% off in‑store for military, veterans, and families through Veterans Day 
 Target: Target Circle Military Appreciation Discount of 20% off one qualifying storewide purchase through Nov. 11 to verified military members, Veterans and their families who are Target Circle members. 
 Tractor Supply Co .: Offering 10% to verified military through Hometown Heroes 
 Walgreens : Offering 20% eligible regular priced items for veterans, active duty military personnel and their immediate families (in-store only) 
 Note: This list is based on information provided by local businesses and/or the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. Veterans and active duty military members looking to take advantage of these promotions should confirm participating locations ahead of time when possible in case information has changed.
